content:
ashley_oncall: paging — seeing a bunch of failed node launches in prod-k8s-us-west. Many of them have docker pull errors from our artifact proxy when fetching CUDA base images. getting 401/429 rapidly. :(
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: P1 - artifact proxy throttle impacting node provisioning (thread 1892104567)
mike_infra: looking now. logs show: 
```
  time=2026-03-15T10:02:11Z level=error msg=\"pull failed\" err=\"received status code 429 from proxy.internal.registry/v2/nvidia/cuda/manifests/12.0\"\n
```
ashley_oncall: confirmed same in several AZs. Provisioner keeps retrying but nodes never reach Ready. autoscaling queue backing up, svc errors rising.
lina_sre: what's the scope? do we have customer impact?
ashley_oncall: some Dedicated pools couldn't spin up new capacity -> some customers hitting degraded throughput and 503s in their inference routes. Not full outage but degraded.
jonah_platform: can we switch new node bootstrap to our internal mirror (mirror.redwood-internal) as a fallback?
mike_infra: mirror has the image but we normally authenticate via proxy that is currently rate-limiting. We can bypass by pointing to mirror and using a short-lived token. Risk: needs quick kubelet config change for the ASG launch template.
ashley_oncall: is there a quick mitigation that doesn't require rolling all hosts? maybe pre-pull images onto a small fleet as a stopgap?
jonah_platform: yes — we can pre-pull on a pre-warm pool and then rotate nodes into the autoscaling group. I'll kick that off if we decide.
ashley_oncall: go for it.
deploy-bot: job started: prepull-cuda-base -> 40 tasks queued
mike_infra: also seeing repeated 401s for some manifests: 
```
  http: error pulling image: unauthorized: authentication required for repository nvidia/cuda
```
  looks like our proxy's token exchange to NV registry is failing intermittently and when it succeeds, rate limits kick in.
lina_sre: ping NVCR support + Docker Hub support? Which upstream is the proxy hitting for these artifacts (nvcr or dockerhub)?
mike_infra: primarily NVCR for the CUDA base layers, but some node types pull from dockerhub for misc tooling images. Both are showing errors from our proxy logs.
ashley_oncall: i've opened a vendor ticket and included logs. vendor ticket: INC-20260315-nvproxy.
incident-bot: @pagerduty page sent to mike_infra, ashley_oncall (oncall)
mike_infra: steps i am running now: 1) throttle proxy consumer threads to reduce bursts 2) increase proxy backoff to avoid fanning 3) enable direct mirror fallback via feature flag on provisioner for the next 5m
jonah_platform: command to flip provisioner fallback (tested in staging): 
```
  curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' https://platform-api/internal/config -d '{"provisioner.fallback_registry":"mirror.redwood-internal", "provisioner.fallback_ttl":300}'
```
mike_infra: applying now.
ashley_oncall: rolling it for us. give a sec.
mike_infra: applied. now restarting provisioner pods: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/provisioner -n infra`
lina_sre: watching logs for failed pulls to drop.
jonah_platform: pre-pull job tasks showing ~95% success after switching to mirror, good sign.
ashley_oncall: traffic metrics: node pending count dropping from 48 -> 12 in last 6m. customer error rate improving but still elevated for some inference clusters.
mike_infra: vendor replied: NVCR acknowledged increased request throttling from our proxy IPs and suggested slower concurrency. they're not seeing a full outage on their side, it's quota exhaustion. dockerhub reply: similar - token service rate-limited.
lina_sre: we should implement these follow-ups: - request higher quota / org-level allowance from NVCR - add jittered exponential backoff in proxy - add local image cache TTL and proactive pre-pull for ASG scale-up - add observability: token-exchange rate metrics
ashley_oncall: agreed. i'll capture in incident doc and assign owners.
incident-bot: escalation: Oncall handoff to lina_sre at 1892105400 (10:10Z).
ashley_oncall: handing off to @lina_sre for next 2 hours, i've got a customer call at 10:15. brief: proxy rate-limits for NVCR/dockerhub causing node bootstrap failures; mitigations applied: provisioner fallback to internal mirror, pre-pull pool created, proxy backoff increased.
lina_sre: taking over. key asks: monitor node readiness and customer error rates; coordinate with vendor support for quota bump; prepare postmortem notes.
mike_infra: also deployed temporary token-cache per-proxy-instance to reduce token exchange QPS. watch for auth error deltas.
jonah_platform: one more quick fix: add startup hook in new-launch-template to `docker pull --retry 5 --disable-content-trust mirror.redwood-internal/nvidia/cuda:12.0` so node will block on pull and not report ready until image is present. Might slow launches but more reliable.
lina_sre: ok implement for next batch, but revert later once upstream stable.
ashley_oncall: customers notified? we have a handful with support cases. Support notified top 5 affected accounts and provided mitigation ETA (~30-45m).
incident-bot: reminder: create incident report with timeline tags: [artifact-proxy][nvcr][rate-limit][node-provisioning]
lina_sre: will own the postmortem draft. logging action items in #incidents-wip.
ashley_oncall: thanks team. I'll join for the first 15m of handoff then off to call.
mike_infra: logs now showing 429s dropping dramatically after reducing concurrency and mirror fallback. continuing to monitor.
jonah_platform: pre-warm pool being drained into ASG now, nodes are becoming Ready.
lina_sre: continuing watch. will update in 15m or on any regression. closing paging loop for ashley. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident P1 -> mitigation in place; will remain open until vendor quota bump confirmed and proxy fixes deployed.
lanes: ACTIONS: [mike_infra] request quota bump from NVCR + dockerhub, [jonah_platform] add pre-pull hook and implement mirror fallback in launch template, [lina_sre] own postmortem and add token-exchange metrics, [ashley_oncall] sync with support on customer comms.
